<function name="GetInvMass" parent="PhysObj" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns 1 divided by the physics object's mass (in kilograms).</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The inverted mass.
			<warning>Returns 0 on frozen physics objects.</warning>
		</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
